slice.candidate: GH Archive passive public-GitHub event archive as an independent retained witness for already-authorized repository-local checkpoint pushes
slice.tested_scope: Official GH Archive project/crawler contract, official GitHub Events/PushEvent schema, and current public visibility of bachikoljunior-blip/note. No direct retrieval of the 2026-09-08T16 UTC raw hourly archive was possible through the currently authorized web surface, so the concrete r298 PushEvent was not observed in this slice.
observations: GH Archive states that it records the public GitHub timeline and aggregates events into hourly raw JSON archives accessible with ordinary HTTP clients; archives are available from 2011 onward.

The open-source crawler polls the global https://api.github.com/events endpoint and writes newly observed events to time-bucketed archive files without per-repository registration, so public repositories are generically in scope rather than opt-in.
bachikoljunior-blip/note is currently public, therefore its public PushEvents are in the crawler's intended source scope, but concrete capture of r298 was not directly verified here.
GitHub's PushEvent payload binds repository_id, push_id, full ref, head SHA and before SHA, so a captured raw event can bind a pushed branch/ref to a resulting commit head.

GH Archive is separately operated from the target repository and retains a copy outside the target repository's own Git object graph, so the target repository administrator cannot directly rewrite the archived record through repository mutation alone.

The raw-download route does not require BigQuery, a cloud project, a hosted runner, registration, or an external write by scheduled Chat. GH Archive's optional BigQuery route is quota-bearing and is not part of this candidate.

Historical availability since 2011 is strong empirical retention evidence, but no contractual indefinite-retention or cryptographic append-only guarantee was established in this bounded slice; GH Archive's operator can in principle alter or remove hosted archive data.

slice.conflict_check: Only cross_field role-local checkpoint/LATEST and immutable own receipt namespaces are authorized for mutation; no scheduler, O, downstream, other-role, protected-primary or external-account mutation is used.

frontier: GH Archive is a materially stronger passive witness than GitHub Events alone because it automatically copies public Events API records into a separately operated long-lived raw archive without requiring the scheduled Chat agent to perform an external mutation or registration.

A captured PushEvent carries ref/head/before binding sufficient to corroborate the existence and branch head of a repository checkpoint push, but the concrete r298 archive record remains unobserved in this run.

Long historical retention is empirical rather than a cryptographic or contractual immutability guarantee, so GH Archive should be treated as a provider-separated corroborator, not yet a durable witness that closes the Phase-1 dependency.
